# Anchor Card Format

> Markdown flashcards, one card per file, in a Git repository the learner owns. Apps read cards and append a review log; people and AI agents write the cards.

The format has exactly one normative document. Read it before writing or editing a card; do not work from memory or from summaries.

## Specification

- [SPEC.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/topo122/anchor-card-format/main/SPEC.md): the complete rules — which files are cards, frontmatter (`id`, `deck`, `tags`, `ask`), the `<!-- back -->` / `<!-- hint -->` / `<!-- note -->` markers, `[[id]]` references, what apps write, and lint.

## Tools

- [lint/anchor-lint.mjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/topo122/anchor-card-format/main/lint/anchor-lint.mjs): the reference linter. `node lint/anchor-lint.mjs <vault>`; exit 1 on errors.
- [skills/anchor-cards/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/topo122/anchor-card-format/main/skills/anchor-cards/SKILL.md): the procedure for writing and repairing cards (no rules of its own).

## Examples

- [examples/](https://github.com/topo122/anchor-card-format/tree/main/examples): lint-clean cards in four subjects.
